getPatientChart(patientId) server action binds access only via canAccessPatientRecords, which returns true for every clinician (permissions.ts line 24: 'clinicians check assignment separately'), but the action performs no separate provider-assignment check — the assignment gate exists only in the clinician chart page. An authenticated clinician can invoke the action directly with an arbitrary patientId and read the full chart (appointments, visit summaries, prescriptions, documents, messages, audit logs). Object lookup line for indirect controller-to-DAO flow.

generateReferralLetter lets any clinician/clinic_admin render any visitSummaryId into a referral PDF with full PHI. Unlike the sibling consult-letter route (line 34: clinician must own summary.provider.userId===session.id), no provider-ownership check binds the selected visit summary to the authenticated clinician, so a clinician can export another provider's patient summaries. viewSharedCareSummary trusts a fully caller-supplied delegation: hasDelegatedAccess is true whenever the request simply passes sharingMode=family and visibilityId=<target patientId> (line 21). The authorization checks at lines 23-28 are thereby bypassed by any authenticated user (patient or staff) to read any patient's released visit summaries — the ownership/delegation binding never involves the authenticated session. viewVisitRecap requires only role==='patient' and then fetches visitSummary by attacker-supplied visitSummaryId with no predicate binding the summary to the authenticated patient (compare refill-recap which scopes with patient:{userId:session.id}). Any patient can enumerate released visitSummary ids and read another patient's diagnosis/treatment/careInstructions. Object lookup line for direct access.

An HTTP response discloses data the caller is not entitled to receive: Returns diagnosis, treatment, and care instructions (health details) from a visitSummary fetched by id without any patient-ownership scope, so an authenticated patient can retrieve another patient's released visit summary.

`completePasswordReset` completes an account-recovery/verification flow — issuing a session or writing a new password — without ever comparing the submitted proof against the stored secret. The account is selected by an attacker-supplied identifier alone, so anyone who knows the email address can take the account over. Compare the proof in constant time against the stored (hashed) value and require it to be unexpired and single-use.
